faq.question: Who is Likith Naidu Anumakonda?
faq.answer: Likith Naidu Anumakonda is an AI/ML Engineer and the Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION. He is currently pursuing a B.Tech in CSE (Artificial Intelligence) at PBR VITS, Kavali, with an Advanced AI/ML specialization programme from IIT Patna (I-HUB). Outside engineering, he is a classical pianist and author of "Echoes of an Unsaid Goodbye".

faq.question: What does Likith specialize in?
faq.answer: Likith focuses on AI and Machine Learning engineering, AI agent and RAG workflows, computer vision automation, and full-stack web application development with Python (FastAPI), Node.js, React, and Next.js.

faq.question: What is RESOLVIT?
faq.answer: RESOLVIT is an AI-assisted civic operations web platform submitted to the GDG Solution Challenge 2026 (Under Evaluation). Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Leaflet, it structures issue triage, clustering, and status tracking for citizens, NGOs, and civic administrators.

faq.question: Can Likith build AI agents and ML models?
faq.answer: Yes. Likith develops applied machine learning models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, local LLM integrations, and task-focused AI assistants in Python.

faq.question: Does Likith build full-stack applications in Python or Node.js?
faq.answer: Yes. He builds backend services and full-stack web applications using Python (FastAPI/Flask) and Node.js (Express/Next.js) alongside React and Tailwind CSS interfaces.

faq.question: Does Likith handle APIs, Middleware, and Deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. His work includes REST API design, authentication middleware, messaging and OTP workflows (Resend, Twilio), PostgreSQL and MySQL database integration, domain configuration, Google Search Console setup, and deployment on platforms like Vercel and Render.

faq.question: What is Likith's role in the Solution Challenge 2026?
faq.answer: Likith led Team SΛKRΛ in building RESOLVIT for the GDG Solution Challenge 2026 (currently Under Evaluation), coordinating AI workflow integration and full-stack delivery.

faq.question: Is Likith open to collaboration or engineering opportunities?
faq.answer: Yes. Likith is open to AI/ML engineering roles, software product collaborations, research discussions, and technical inquiries via the Collaboration page or email.
